note: Twelve small, peaceful missions for Harr, two for each principle of the charter. Each step is one of five recorded facts (resident.met, landmark.visited, pantry.delivered, account.linked, landmark.together) and a count of DISTINCT targets, so the same person or place is never counted twice. Missions only point the way: they give no rewards and no rank, and nobody can miss one. Three are shown each day, in catalogue order, by the host computer's date.

missions.title: A page for the next reader
missions.blurb: Write down what you learn so the next person starts further on.

steps.label: Stand a few seconds in a discovery place from the library.
Greet two villagers and ask what they are working on.
Add two more places to the library.

missions.title: Insight for everyone
missions.blurb: Every find teaches the whole village something new.

steps.label: Find two places; each one adds insight for all.
Stand at a building site with neighbours and watch the work.
Ask four different villagers what the village is learning.
Bring the library to five places in all.

missions.title: Many hands
missions.blurb: Big works need a crew. Come and stand with it.

steps.label: Meet three builders, makers or neighbours near the plaza.
Stand with a crew at a building site.
Visit a second site and stand with its crew too.

missions.title: A warm welcome
missions.blurb: Harr grows when newcomers feel at home.

steps.label: Introduce yourself to five villagers.
Share a first meal from the free pantry.
Keep your progress in NemoWorld by linking your account with Lyra.
Join neighbours at a place in the village.

missions.title: To the edge of the valley
missions.blurb: The valley is full of things worth finding.

steps.label: Find your first discovery place.
Find four places in all, a few steps from the plaza each.
Seven places make a studious valley.

missions.title: Share the table
missions.blurb: There is enough. The pantry is open to everyone.

steps.label: Take something from the pantry; ask Selene for an apple.
Tell three villagers what you ate; farmers love to hear.
Come back for a second helping on another visit.

missions.title: The catalogue keeper
missions.blurb: A good catalogue is a gift to every scholar after you.

steps.label: Record five places for the library.
Link your account so your name stays on your pages.
Compare notes with six different villagers.
Record eight places in all.

missions.title: Field season
missions.blurb: Careful looking, again and again, is how research grows.

steps.label: Visit three discovery places and read their field notes.
Stand with neighbours at two different places.
Extend the survey to six places.
Share what you found with eight villagers.

missions.title: Good neighbours
missions.blurb: A village is the people who keep each other company.

steps.label: Say hello to four neighbours.
Stand with others at a shared place.
Share a snack from the pantry beside a neighbour.
Visit three shared places in the village.

missions.title: Rising Harr
missions.blurb: Harr is never finished. Come and see what is rising.

steps.label: Ask two builders what is going up next.
Find two places where the next homes could stand.
Stand at two building sites.
Link your account so the village remembers you.

missions.title: The whole valley
missions.blurb: Ten places, ten pages, one complete catalogue.

steps.label: Find three places.
Find six places.
Complete the catalogue: all ten places.

missions.title: Orchard and oven
missions.blurb: What the fields give, the village shares.

steps.label: Share two helpings from the pantry.
Thank six villagers for the fields, tools and lamps.
Share a third helping with a friend.
Link your account so your meals are kept in your story.
